en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I might fall asleep...
The video rack is bothering me...
We should focus on reality, not movies
You do not need to worry about that.

If you do fall asleep, I will carry you to
your room without waking you.

I am quite confident in my strength. With your
weight, I only need an arm to lift you.

That is true. It looks quite unsightly because
the movies are not in orderly fashion.

It was bothering me as well.
I will fix it immediately.

Because you are a detective,
you notice such details...

But perhaps you have the makings of
a butler as well?
I see. So that is what you think.

If you are asking for my opinion, then
I am sorry. I do not have an answer.

Whichever opinion my client chooses,
then I will follow... That is all.
I have told you how maids think, no?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
